name: date-picker
purpose: Date field that combines a segmented Date Input (date granularity) with a calendar button opening a Calendar in a non-modal dialog popup (WAI-ARIA APG date picker dialog). Typing and picking produce the same PlainDate value; the picker is the form control Form discovers.
whenToUse: Dates users may either type or look up by day of week (appointments, travel, deadlines).
Forms that need a date field with min/max bounds and unavailable days.
whenNotToUse: Well-known dates such as birth dates: use Date Input (a calendar makes distant years slow to reach).
Exact moments with a time of day: use DateTime Picker.
Date ranges: use Date Range Picker.
states: invalid (Date Input errors, unavailable day, custom)
responsive: The field fits its content like Date Input; the popup is positioned under the field by the positioning engine, flips above when there is no room, and scrolls when taller than the available height.
rtl: Segment order follows the locale; the calendar button sits at the inline end of the field. The popup aligns to the field's inline start, and the calendar mirrors arrows and chevrons.
theme: Date Input and Calendar tokens plus surface, border, shadow, hover, and focus tokens for the popup and button. Forced-colors mode draws a CanvasText popup border.
timezone: Values are PlainDate (no timezone). The configured timezone (default UTC, never the host zone) only determines 'today' in the calendar, which is focused when the field is empty.
security: All text via textContent and Intl formatting; no HTML parsing. The popup uses the Popover API (top layer), no inline styles or handlers. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. The inner Date Input's hidden input carries the ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) when `name` is set.

performance.testedScale: One calendar per picker, created once and reused on every open.

limitations: Gregorian calendar only; years 1-9999 (Date Input range).
Single dates only; for ranges use Date Range Picker.
Validation messages follow Date Input timing (incomplete and required after blur or reportValidity); validationTiming is not supported.
A typed day rejected by isDateDisabled is reported as error 'custom' with the message 'This date is not available.'; a consumer custom error takes precedence.
The popup has no Cancel/OK buttons: picking a day commits it.
unsupported: Minute granularity (use Date Input with granularity 'minute').
Rendering HTML in the label, help text, or messages.
antiPatterns: Making the calendar the only way to enter a date; the segments stay available for keyboard and screen-reader users.
Using a Date Picker for birth dates.
Relying on the host timezone for 'today'; configure `timezone`.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/date-picker: AuiDatePicker directive ([auiDatePicker]) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/date-picker: AuiDatePicker component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
